question:
A @ B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A & B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

If Z # L @ P & K @ J # X, then how is K related to Z?

**Given expression: **Z # L @ P & K @ J # X

It means: Z is daughter of L, L is husband of P, P is mother of K, K is husband of J and J is daughter of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f2eb67880ab7f8225a9d6e1749ec42310b8f0f727afb2005b829734d9116e5a.png] 

So,** K** is brother of **Z.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
